E0131

`Float` and `Decimal` mixed (D-DECIMAL1)

What

`Float` and `Decimal` mixed (D-DECIMAL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0131

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0131: tests/ui/decimal_float_mix.stderr.

Error [E0131]: `Float` and `Decimal` can't be mixed — got `Decimal (an exact base-10 number)` and `Float (an approximate binary number)`
  --> tests/ui/decimal_float_mix.jet:9:11
    |
  9 |     print(price + rate)
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: precise numeric types never mix with fixed-width integers or floats without an explicit constructor
 Fix: use `Decimal("…")` for exact money arithmetic; `Float` is for approximate science
